concept.title: Roast Day, Circled
concept.hook: Macro of a hand drawing a circle around a date on a paper calendar page, morning light. Overlay: Roasted this week.
concept.surpriseBeat: The calendar circle in the opening shot is matched by the same date reappearing on the doorstep box, linking roast day to arrival in one cut.

locations.description: Small nook with a window, wooden desk, paper calendar on the wall
locations.lighting: Soft natural window light with creamy highlights

locations.description: Sunlit home kitchen counter with a hand grinder, small scale and pour-over setup
locations.lighting: Warm window light, lifted shadows, fine film grain

scenes.action: A hand in a rolled oatmeal sleeve circles a date on a paper calendar page with a pen. No readable numbers are shown, just the red circle.
scenes.framing: Tight macro on the calendar page and pen tip
scenes.motion: Pen draws one slow circle, then lifts away
scenes.lighting: Soft window light from the left
scenes.sound: Pen scratch on paper, quiet room tone, fingerpicked guitar begins

scenes.action: The cream coffee bag sits on the counter. A hand folds back the top and beans tilt from the bag into a small scale.
scenes.framing: Medium shot at counter height, bag label facing camera, hand entering from the side above the label
scenes.motion: Bag tilts gently, beans slide into the scale
scenes.sound: Beans rattling into a metal scale, soft upright bass

scenes.action: Beans go into the hand grinder. The person turns the crank in profile, then the grounds bloom under a slow pour-over.
scenes.framing: Profile of shoulders and hands, shallow depth of field, then macro on the bloom
scenes.motion: Steady crank turns, steam rises from the bloom
scenes.sound: Crisp grinding, soft bubbling bloom, brushed percussion

scenes.action: Cut to a front porch: a shipping box sits on the step. A second adult in a linen shirt lifts it and carries it inside. The same hand-drawn circle is visible on a small tag on the box.
scenes.motion: Person walks the box through the doorway
scenes.sound: Footsteps, cardboard shift, light hand-clap accent

scenes.action: The bag rests on the counter, one-way valve visible, a full mug beside it. Beans scattered in front.
scenes.framing: Centered on the bag with room above for captions
scenes.motion: Steam drifts from the mug, nothing else moves
scenes.overlayText: 12 oz bag. Monthly option. Try a bag.
scenes.sound: Final guitar chord, gentle hand-clap on the last beat

rubric.reason: Calendar circle is a distinctive, brief-based hook and the product is used in a real brew. The surprise is gentle, a quiet visual link rather than a jolt.

concept.title: The Bag Opens the Morning
concept.hook: Hand tears the folded top of the cream bag, camera at counter height. Overlay: Tear open the bag. Notice the difference.
concept.surpriseBeat: Mid-brew, the cut snaps from the steady pour to the sealed bag on a doorstep, revealing where the beans began before returning to the mug.

locations.description: Sunlit home kitchen counter with scale, hand grinder, pour-over dripper and mug
locations.lighting: Natural window light, warm soft grade

locations.description: Front porch step with a plain delivery box

scenes.action: A hand tears open the folded top of the cream bag. The label faces camera, the hand stays at the top edge.
scenes.framing: Medium close at counter height, shallow depth of field
scenes.overlayText: Tear open the bag. Notice the difference.

scenes.action: The bag tilts and beans pour into a small scale, then a hand moves them into a hand grinder and cranks.
scenes.framing: Top-down on the counter, scale and grinder in frame
scenes.motion: Beans slide, crank turns in a steady rhythm
scenes.lighting: Even soft light from the window
scenes.dialogue: Plain tasting notes on every bag.
scenes.sound: Beans clattering, grinder crunch, brushed percussion

scenes.action: Grounds bloom in the pour-over, then a steady pour fills the dripper while the person watches in profile.
scenes.framing: Macro on the bloom, then profile of the person

scenes.action: Quick insert: the plain shipping box on the porch step, a second adult picks it up and carries it inside.
scenes.framing: Wide shot of the porch step
scenes.motion: Person lifts box and walks into the house
scenes.sound: Box lifted, door closing, light hand-clap

scenes.action: The bag stands on the counter with the valve visible, a filled mug beside it, beans in front.
scenes.framing: Centered on bag and beans, space for captions
scenes.overlayText: 12 oz bag. Monthly option. Try a bag.
scenes.dialogue: Try a bag. We roast it weekly.
scenes.sound: Final guitar strum, soft hand-clap on last beat

rubric.reason: Strong tactile hook and the bag drives the whole brew. The porch cut is a mild twist but clearly the one escalation beat.

concept.title: Counter Height Ritual
concept.hook: Macro of whole beans sliding across a scale, steam in the background. Overlay: Your morning cup should know its roast date.
concept.surpriseBeat: A single hard cut on the grinder's last crank to total silence and a still macro of beans, then the music returns warmer.

locations.description: Sunlit home kitchen counter with linen towel, scale, grinder and mug

scenes.action: Beans tumble onto a small scale from the open cream bag at the edge of frame.
scenes.framing: Macro on beans and scale, bag softly out of focus
scenes.lighting: Side window light with creamy highlights
scenes.overlayText: Your morning cup should know its roast date.
scenes.sound: Beans settling on metal, fingerpicked guitar

scenes.action: Person in an oatmeal knit sweater cranks the hand grinder, seen in profile.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of shoulders and hands at counter height

scenes.action: The last crank stops. Sound drops out for a beat over a still macro of fresh grounds, then the pour-over bloom swells.
scenes.motion: Grounds still, then rise as water lands
scenes.sound: One beat of silence, then soft bloom hiss and bass returns

scenes.action: A steady pour fills the dripper, then the mug is set on the counter next to the bag.
scenes.framing: Medium side view of the counter
scenes.overlayText: Plain tasting notes on every bag.
scenes.sound: Water trickle, mug touching the counter

scenes.action: Bag and beans held in a centered still, valve visible, mug steaming beside.
scenes.overlayText: 12 oz bag. Monthly option. Try a bag.

rubric.reason: Very clear calm mood and a clean single-location shoot. The silence beat is subtle and the hook is less distinctive than the other two.
